data.name: Behind:The hidden Truth
data.detailed_description:
Only those who piece together the clues can face the truth.

'Behind' is a narrative-driven adventure that goes beyond a simple mystery. Players must meticulously investigate crime scenes and piece together scattered clues like a puzzle to uncover the truth hidden beneath the surface of each case.

You will be completely immersed in the story through its deeply engaging narrative, detailed scene direction, and profound psychological portrayal of the characters.

Consequential Choices: Your every decision influences the plot's development, leading to unpredictable and diverse endings.

Diverse Cast: Meet a host of distinct characters and find the clues that will lead you closer to the truth.

Synopsis

In the world of Barheim, where magic and mechanical engineering coexist, we follow Detective Hind. On his journey to a passenger ship for a party he was invited to, he encounters unexpected incidents and begins to pursue the truth. Gather evidence from the incidents in each stage and cross-examine the suspects to reveal the full truth of the cases!

The first case begins in an alley as Hind is on his way to the harbor. Drawn by a strange sound, he approaches the alley to find a man collapsed, with traces of someone hastily leaving something behind scattered around. Players must analyze the clues gathered from the scene and compare the conflicting testimonies of witnesses to personally deduce who the culprit is.

Every case has a story behind it.
